 The Adelaide Strikers have named a 13-player squad for their second match of the WBBL|12 season, with the side set to take on the Brisbane Heat at Drummoyne Oval tomorrow afternoon.
Veteran fast bowler Megan Schutt returns to the squad, providing a significant boost through her experience, leadership and proven ability with the ball.
The Strikers head into the contest full of confidence after opening their campaign with a hard-fought 21-run victory over the Melbourne Stars at Karen Rolton Oval on Saturday in front of more than 1,500 fans.
South African opener Laura Wolvaardt made an impressive start to the season, producing a classy 70 at the top of the order, while Amanda-Jade Wellington was named Player of the Match after claiming 3/22 from her four overs.
